t: This is the statue of Lord Byron at Hyde Park Corner. It's bronze, designed by the sculptor Richard Claude Belt, and it sits on a marble plinth. The marble was a gift from the people of Greece, in recognition of Byron's part in the Greek War of Independence. Byron is regarded as one of the greatest British poets and a major figure of the Romantic movement. He's best known for the long narratives Don Juan and Childe Harold's Pilgrimage, and for shorter lyrics from Hebrew Melodies.
